boundaries: Reuses hash-checked saved JAX candidates and evaluation evidence; no new training or test evaluation.
The plan requires matching evaluation and selection evidence. No data-lineage receipt is invented for the raw-input GP example.
The first durable publication is observed in a real publisher response and supplemental callback before stage failure; FootPrint discards its uncommitted scope writes.
The retry creates a fresh Python worker and publisher client, reloads the same prediction model and reuses the same pinned plan, prepared artifact and idempotency key.
The publisher is a local filesystem reference implementation; this proof does not establish cloud registry, multi-host or distributed exactly-once behavior.
